title: Azure AI Foundry routine service
description: Service-level configuration for a host: azure.ai.routine entry. The service key is the routine name. A routine is a scheduled or event-driven invocation of an agent declared as an azure.ai.agent service; the routine service must uses: the agent it invokes. Extension-owned authoring keys use camelCase and are translated to the Foundry API wire contract during deployment.

$ref.description: Local YAML or JSON routine manifest path. Sibling service properties override referenced values.

triggers.description: Triggers keyed by a user-defined identifier (commonly 'default'). Each trigger selects a variant via its type (schedule, timer, github_issue, or custom).

cronExpression.description: Cron expression for a schedule trigger.

timeZone.description: Time zone for a schedule trigger.

at.description: Fire time for a one-shot timer trigger.

connectionId.description: Foundry connection name or ID for a GitHub issue trigger.

owner.description: GitHub repository owner for a GitHub issue trigger.

repository.description: GitHub repository name for a GitHub issue trigger.

provider.description: Provider name for a custom trigger.

eventName.description: Event name for a custom trigger.

parameters.description: Provider-owned custom trigger parameters. Property names are passed through unchanged.

action.description: What the routine does when it fires. Invokes an agent by name.

agentName.description: Name of the azure.ai.agent service the routine invokes.

agentEndpointId.description: Existing Foundry agent endpoint ID the routine invokes.

input.description: Static JSON input sent to the agent when the routine fires. Values may use ${VAR} declared in the service-level env object or ${{...}} for Foundry server-side resolution.
